**FINDING #12 RESOLVED + diagnosis corrected: the live MR-B fail was operator error (literal #<IID> placeholder = case A), NOT glab; #12 fix ships by code evidence; the new message discriminated it**

What: RESOLUTION + diagnosis correction. The CP-A2b MR-B issue-link log (captured) showed the failure was at the BODY stage (~0.5s, NO network call) — the `issueView`/`glab` path was NEVER reached. Root cause was OPERATOR ERROR (case A): the compliant MR was created with the literal placeholder `#<APPROVED_ISSUE_IID>` (no digit), so the shared CLOSING_RE (`#(\d+)`) didn't match → issueLink returned "no issue reference found". So the ORIGINAL live-crash attribution to glab (in the first #12 note) was WRONG for that run.

BUT #12 is still a REAL bug and its fix SHIPS — by CODE evidence, not the (never-happened) live crash: the CI image genuinely lacks `glab`, so IF issueView were reached it would ENOENT. The fix (issueView → direct API v4 via the shared gitlab-api.mjs) is justified by the image fact + the anti-spawn test that now GUARDS it (proves the default path spawns no CLI). This is the correct epistemic posture: ship on code evidence + a guarding test, not on reproducing a crash.

Bonus validation: the self-diagnostic message distinction (commit 780f9c5 — null-body "context API fetch failed" vs string-without-ref "no issue reference found") is EXACTLY what let us discriminate (A) description-error from (B) token/binary. Without it the blind cycle would have repeated. The pattern proved its worth on first use.

Status: #236 APPROVED complete (node:22 + version-assert, single fetcher, anti-spawn test, glab→local-only, runbook re-run step, self-diagnostic message). Human merges → re-push mirror → update test/* branches (merge feature/v2.0.0 + push) → re-run. MR-B with a CORRECTED description (real issue IID) should yield 5 REQUIRED green; if not, the new message pinpoints why.

Runbook robustness follow-up (tiny, optional): the runbook should tell the operator to VERIFY the MR-B description has a real digit issue number, not the literal `#<APPROVED_ISSUE_IID>` placeholder. Where: brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs (issueView, fixed), run-check.mjs (self-diagnostic message), cp-a2b-runbook.md. Related: [[findings/13-node20-glob-node-test-ci]].
